parametrized_description: A state is planning its electricity capacity for T time periods. The demand for electricity each period is Demand. Existing oil-fired plants provide capacity OilCap each period. The state can build coal plants at cost CoalCost per unit of capacity and nuclear plants at cost NukeCost per unit of capacity. Nuclear power must not exceed MaxNuke fraction of total capacity. Coal plants last CoalLife periods and nuclear plants last NukeLife periods. Determine how much coal and nuclear capacity to build each period to minimize total construction cost while meeting demand.

Demand.description: Demand for electricity in each time period

OilCap.description: Available capacity from existing oil-fired plants in each time period

CoalCost.description: Cost per unit of capacity for building a coal plant

NukeCost.description: Cost per unit of capacity for building a nuclear plant

MaxNuke.description: Maximum fraction of total capacity that can be nuclear

CoalLife.description: Lifespan of a coal plant in time periods

NukeLife.description: Lifespan of a nuclear plant in time periods

CoalBuilt.description: Amount of coal capacity built in each time period

NukeBuilt.description: Amount of nuclear capacity built in each time period

constraints.description: Total available capacity (oil + active coal + active nuclear) must meet demand in each period.

code.gurobipy:
for t in range(T):
    coal_active = quicksum(CoalBuilt[s] for s in range(max(0, t - CoalLife + 1), t + 1))
    nuke_active = quicksum(NukeBuilt[s] for s in range(max(0, t - NukeLife + 1), t + 1))
    model.addConstr(OilCap[t] + coal_active + nuke_active >= Demand[t], name=f"DemandMet_{t}")

constraints.description: Nuclear capacity must not exceed MaxNuke fraction of total capacity in each period.
constraints.formulation: \sum_{s=\max(1,t-NukeLife+1)}^{t} NukeBuilt_s \leq MaxNuke \times \left( OilCap_t + \sum_{s=\max(1,t-CoalLife+1)}^{t} CoalBuilt_s + \sum_{s=\max(1,t-NukeLife+1)}^{t} NukeBuilt_s \right) \quad \forall t

code.gurobipy:
for t in range(T):
    coal_active = quicksum(CoalBuilt[s] for s in range(max(0, t - CoalLife + 1), t + 1))
    nuke_active = quicksum(NukeBuilt[s] for s in range(max(0, t - NukeLife + 1), t + 1))
    model.addConstr(nuke_active <= MaxNuke * (OilCap[t] + coal_active + nuke_active), name=f"NukeLimit_{t}")

constraints.description: Capacity built in each period must be non-negative.

code.gurobipy:
model.addConstrs((CoalBuilt[t] >= 0 for t in range(T)), name="CoalNonNeg")
model.addConstrs((NukeBuilt[t] >= 0 for t in range(T)), name="NukeNonNeg")

objective.description: Minimize total cost of building coal and nuclear plants over all periods.

code.gurobipy: model.setObjective(quicksum(CoalCost * CoalBuilt[t] + NukeCost * NukeBuilt[t] for t in range(T)), GRB.MINIMIZE)
